reviews.author: Sue Lynn Tiong
reviews.text:
Dr Ong and her team at iSmile Dental Clinic have been caring for my teeth (and smile) for nearly 15 years, and they’ve done a great job throughout. From routine scaling to more complex procedures such as managing tooth erosion, bite height building, and creating natural-looking veneers, they consistently deliver.

Treatment approach is holistic and focused on long-term oral health — something I really appreciate. I place far greater importance on the health of my teeth than on quick, purely aesthetic fixes, and I feel iSmile upholds that philosophy.

I definitely recommend them to those who want a dental clinic that prioritises long-term care of their teeth.

reviews.author: Andy Tey
reviews.text: Dr. Ma is very professional and highly experienced in orthodontics. Truly appreciate the care and expertise!

reviews.author: Eugene Lee
reviews.text:
I’ve been coming to iSmile Dental Clinic for my checkups and have always had a great experience. The front desk is friendly, and Dr. Jean Ong is incredibly thorough and attentive.

But quick tips: Be sure to book an appointment ahead of time because slots fill up quickly. There is also reserved parking spots in front of the clinic, but if those are full, you can park at Atria Mall and walk over.

Overall, it’s a clean, professional clinic with excellent service. I’d definitely return and highly recommend it for any dental care!

reviews.author: Max Loh
reviews.text:
I’ve been a regular at iSmile for almost 3 years now. Dr. Jean is very professional, warm and caring. I used to find scaling quite uncomfortable with previous dentists, but she always makes the experience smooth and pain-free.

I also did teeth whitening here, and the photo shows the progress I made after just one week of the treatment. Being in the sales line, having a brighter smile has definitely helped my confidence when meeting with clients.

The clinic has a nice homey feel and is a family-friendly environment. The staff at the front desk are also easy-going and friendly. Definitely recommend.

My family’s dental health are securely in the hands of iSmile.

reviews.author: Jared
reviews.text: At the risk of sounding like overselling - Dr Amy is by far the most competent and educational dentist I've been to. I've been to a few, so I can really see the difference. Dr. Amy takes time to assess your dental condition and thoroughly explained all possible avenues. She personally shows you how to brush your teeth, open up the computer to show you articles and information to educate you, and you can tell she really knows her stuff and genuinely cares for her patient. Give her a try and compare to the one you are currently seeing and you'll notice the disparity.
